messages.subject: Re: Jake Essex for Watford Ex-Servicemen's & Social Club?
messages.body:
Hi,

Quick bump on Jake Essex for Watford Ex-Servicemen's & Social Club. He's a proper 50s/60s rock and roll singer (himself, not a tribute), own PA, no deposit. Ex-servicemen's clubs are where he goes down best.

Indicative fee is from £250 for two one hour sets. If a Friday or Saturday in the months ahead could work, reply here and I'll send free dates, or pass me to the entertainment person.

Happy to leave it if it's not a fit. Just say "no thanks".

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
www.jakeessex.co.uk
